## Past Offers

### 2025

:::: {.entry}
#### Evaluation of Approaches for Identifying High-Dimensional Individual-Level Surrogate Markers Applied to Vaccinology

**Description:** Proposition for a 6 month internship for a master's student, co-supervised by myself and Boris Hejblum. The subject of the internship is the comparison of methods for identifying individual-level surrogate markers of the vaccine response. The project was completed by Master student Roaya Jannatipour.

[View internship offer](internships/Internship_proposal_25_26_ILS.pdf){.pill target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}

:::: {.entry}
#### Evaluation of Gene Expression as Trial-Level Surrogate Markers of Vaccination Across Multiple Settings

**Description:** Proposition for a 6 month internship for a master's student, co-supervised by myself and Boris Hejblum. The subject of the internship is the evaluation of trial-level surrogate markers of the vaccine response using our recently developed approach, using meta-analysis tools to evaluate the generalisability of signatures across multiple clinical trials.

[View internship offer](internships/Internship_proposal_25_26_TLS.pdf){.pill target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}
::::

### 2024

:::: {.entry}
#### Evaluating High-Dimensional Surrogate Markers of the Yellow Fever Vaccine Response

**Description:** Proposition for a 6 month internship for a master's student, co-supervised by myself and Boris Hejblum. The subject of the internship was the identification and evaluation of high-dimensional trial-level surrogate markers of the vaccine response to yellow fever vaccination. The project was completed by Master student Theodora Georgakopoulou.
